# SheetJS CE

`xlsx.mjs` is the official SheetJS CE 0.20.3 ESM distribution:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs

Apache-2.0 license: `SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt`.
SHA-256: `1a0fb062ee9781b13f6687371b202aaefc53b6ce55b530c027e01f9c087b77db`.
It is bundled into the Excel parsing worker by Vite; no external script is loaded at runtime.
